brief.title: Hunger Doesn't Wait — Together We Can End It
brief.one_liner: 48 million Americans face hunger, but a united network of food banks, volunteers, and advocates is fighting back with billions of meals every year.
brief.goal: Inspire viewers to understand the scale of hunger in America and motivate them to take action — whether through donating, volunteering, advocating, or fundraising.

sections.title: The Hunger Crisis in America
sections.objective: Present the scale of food insecurity across the U.S. with key statistics on affected populations, including children.

sections.title: Our Collective Impact
sections.objective: Showcase the measurable outcomes of the Feeding America network — meals distributed, food rescued, programs operated, and food banks mobilized.

sections.title: How We Unite Communities
sections.objective: Explain the four pillars of the approach: research-driven insights, local relationships, nationwide scale, and nutrition-focused vision.

sections.title: How You Can Make a Difference
sections.objective: Present clear calls to action — donate, advocate, fundraise, and volunteer — with a compelling reason for each.
